newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zairean rebels return abducted children--UNICEF.
newsitem.headline: Zairean rebels return abducted children--UNICEF.

text.p: Fifty-two Rwandan refugee children returned by Zairean rebels have been verified to be those abducted from a hospital near Bukavu almost a week ago, a UNICEF spokesman said on Friday.
UNICEF spokesman Patrick McCormick told Reuters: "Cross-checking by agencies has finished and has verified the children returned are the same as those abducted."
The 52 children were abducted by armed men early last Saturday from a paediatric hospital at Lwiro, about 30 km (20 miles) north of Bukavu, in rebel-held territory in eastern Zaire.
The children and 10 adults were handed over to UNICEF on Wednesday evening at Bukavu by the rebels following a stiff U.N. protest expressing concern over their fate.
The U.N. refugee agency has said that 60 adults were also taken away in the Lwiro incident, but UNICEF has maintained that the figure for the missing adults was far lower.

McCormick said UNICEF, Medecins Sans Frontieres (Doctors Without Borders) and other non-governmental organisations had verified the identity of the children returned, whom he said were in "pretty bad condition". But he had no information from UNICEF officials in the region that any of them bore wounds.
